continue_without_reapproval: Ordinary reversible code edits inside the authorized branch
Dependency pinning that meets the approved architecture and existing repository constraints
Safe bug fixes needed to pass an approved gate
pause_and_report: An approved artifact contradicts another at the same authority level
A product behavior decision is genuinely absent
Required credentials or external permissions are unavailable
A destructive or production external action is required
A failed safety/knowledge/accessibility/rights gate cannot be fixed within approved scope
Existing user changes overlap materially with the planned edit
never_do: Invent canon, hidden facts or character appearance invariants
Treat browser state as canonical authority
Retry an unknown commit before status lookup
Expose protected media audit or hidden truth to the client
Force-push, hard-reset or discard unrelated user work
Claim manual/human gates passed without evidence
